issues.description: Retry loop retries non-idempotent batch-create POSTs on 5xx, risking duplicate task creation without idempotency keys.
Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without path-segment encoding, so reserved characters can misroute requests.
Pagination silently treats missing items as an empty page, hiding malformed success responses and risking data loss.
Batch responses are trusted without checking result count, duplicate indices, or out-of-range indices.
BatchItemResult accepts invalid status/result combinations instead of enforcing created/error invariants.
Retry-After parsing ignores HTTP-date values and allows uncapped numeric delays that can hang callers.
Package has type hints but does not ship a py.typed marker, so downstream type checkers may treat it as untyped.
Mock server returns scripted responses before auth checks, which can mask authentication behavior in retry tests.
Mock batch endpoint assumes every task item is a dict and can crash instead of returning a structured 400.
Package version is duplicated with lumen/__init__.py, creating release drift risk.
Runtime __version__ is manually duplicated instead of sourced from package metadata.
